summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 attendance changes (bulk statuses, admin employee-picker calendar on Regularize, instant convert dialog, rotational week-off/absent). All 7 acceptance criteria PASS across Super Admin, Office Admin, and Staff roles.

issues: React accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Cosmetic a11y warning only; no functional impact.

Staff's own month calendar Card on the Regularize tab is wrapped in class 'sm:hidden', so on desktop (>=640px) only the New-request button + My-requests list is shown; calendar visible only on mobile viewport. Element is present in DOM (data-testid=attendance-calendar) but visually hidden. Confirm this is intended (staff still sees calendar under the primary Attendance tab).

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to admin-convert-dialog and reg-dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Consider un-hiding the staff calendar on desktop for Regularize tab or remove sm:hidden if requirement 'staff self-view still shows their own calendar' is meant to apply on desktop too.
critical_code_review_comments: AttendanceCalendar.jsx correctly treats past days without a record as 'absent' with no Sunday-dimming - rotational week-off works as specified. Verified visually: past Sundays (e.g. Sept 6 2026) render rose/red like any other absent day.
AdminEmployeeAttendance.applyConvert posts to /attendance/admin/upsert and reloads records immediately — instant apply confirmed (violet cell after Week-off apply, rose after revert to Absent).

BulkUploadDialog TEMPLATES.attendance.hint now includes all 9 statuses (present, absent, late, half day, week-off, casual leave, sick leave, paid leave, unpaid leave). Preview parses week-off→weekoff, casual/sick/paid leave→leave(<type>), unpaid leave→absent(unpaid), half day→half_day, invalid→error. Confirmed.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set 2026-09-01 for Fathima Telecaller to 'weekoff' via admin/upsert; immediately reverted to 'absent' via the same dialog. No lingering seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance Regularize tab: admin card testid=admin-emp-attendance; dropdown=admin-emp-select; month nav=admin-emp-prev/-month/-next (next disabled at current month e.g. Sep 2026); calendar cells testid=cal-day-YYYY-MM-DD; past Sundays now render rose (Absent) — rotational week-off. Convert dialog=admin-convert-dialog with admin-convert-{present|weekoff|leave|absent} + admin-convert-leave-type (revealed only when Leave selected) + admin-convert-apply. Payroll tab bulk upload button testid=bulk-upload-btn opens bulk-upload-dialog; select bulk-kind-attendance, fill bulk-csv, click bulk-preview-btn; preview rows appear as bulk-prow-<line>. Preview verified: week-off→weekoff, casual/sick/paid leave→leave(casual|sick|paid), unpaid leave→absent(unpaid), half day→half_day, invalid→error row. Office admin (blr1@finflow.com) sees 6 scoped employees (KM_BLR only). Staff sees no admin card, has reg-new-btn + reg-dialog; own calendar hidden on desktop via sm:hidden.
